additional_info.subject: RE: ID0416107-DC/Si-D/IL-[MP / P4 170000461] OCPI not responding. CRM:02682000021
additional_info.body:
Hello Itai,
For me, it looks like this is a backend issue because we, as chargers, don't receive any OCPI communication. This communication is only e.g. between the backend and the payment provider. Therefore, we cannot answer why the backend is sending the long ID, as it is not a processed value. But as per OCPP the IdTag can only be 20 digits.
Thank you.
With best regards,
Semih Sentürk
